newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines declares Nov 22 to 26 holiday for APEC.
newsitem.headline: Philippines declares Nov 22 to 26 holiday for APEC.

text.p: Philippine President Fidel Ramos declared a special holiday from November 22 to 26 in Manila and Subic free port in view of the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum summit.
Ramos, in an order issued on Wednesday, said the holiday is "to ensure free and unhampered flow of traffic in the said areas to maximise the productive hours of the delegates".
APEC ministers begin their meetings in Manila on November 22 while the leaders will meet for their annual summit on November 25 at Subic, 80 kms (50 miles) north of Manila.
Ramos said important private sector service companies such as banks, hotels, restaurants, utility companies, construction companies and manufacturing companies were exempt from the order.
All government offices, except law enforcement and revenue generating agencies, would also be closed during the period.
